ios.desc:
Rediscover note-taking with Notestudio—a perfect fusion of pen-and-paper charm and robust digital tools. Effortlessly capture, organize, and create with multi-page notes tailored to your ideas. The PDF markup feature is a fantastic bonus.


KEY FEATURES
• Flexible note sizes: A4, Letter, or Screen
• Paper styles: Plain, graph, lined, or dotted
• Paper colors: White, yellowish, bluish, dark gray, or black
• Organize with custom folders and a favorites option
• Add photos, scan documents, or copy/paste content
• Export as PDF, PNG, HEIC, or JPEG
• PDF markup / annotation

TOOLS
• Fineliner, Ink Pen, and Calligraphy Pen with auto-shape support
• Highlighter and Round Highlighter
• Object Eraser, Pixel Eraser
• Laser tools: Stroke Laser, Point Laser
• Easy selection: Text, images, or strokes
• Text input

DRAWING ENGINE
• Low-latency drawing with pressure, angle, and tilt sensitivity
• Smart stabilization for smooth strokes
• Crisp, anti-aliased vector lines
• Realistic "pigment" color mixing
• High-quality vector PDF export and print

INTUITIVE INTERFACE
• Clean, user-friendly layout
• Drag panels to customize your workspace
• Split View support on iPadOS for dual-note editing
• Full-screen mode for focused creativity

--
